title: DIY Face Mask Using Pillowcase and Rubber Band
author: Jernej Turnšek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be2mjgc6

steps.title: Gather Materials
steps.instruction: Collect a pillowcase piece (~14 inch x ~20 inch / ~36 cm x ~51 cm), a coffee filter, and 2 rubber bands.

steps.title: Prepare Fabric and Filter
steps.instruction: Fold the pillowcase piece twice along the longer edge and sandwich a coffee filter between the fabric layers.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Use alternative filter materials such as HEPA vacuum filters/bags (fiberglass-free), air conditioner filters (fiberglass-free), or non-woven polypropylene grocery store tote bags.

steps.title: Insert Rubber Bands
steps.instruction: Insert both ends of the folded fabric piece through a rubber band.

substeps.instruction: Note: Two long twisted rubber bands can be used.

steps.title: Assemble and Fit Mask
steps.instruction: Fold both outer flaps back to the middle to create 9 fabric protection layers, then secure the mask behind the ears with the flaps-containing side covering the face.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Wrap a small piece of moist paper towel around the rubber bands for increased comfort.

steps.title: Clean and Maintain Mask
steps.instruction: Perform post-use maintenance on the mask components.

substeps.instruction: Discard the coffee filter after each use.
Disinfect the fabric by boiling it in water for 5 min.
Dry the fabric thoroughly before reuse.
Discard the fabric after 10 wash cycles.
